notes: RP samples are ribosome footprints. RNA samples: 'fragments of total mRNA ... size selected via gel purification' (Oh et al. 2011 protocol, likely short fragments) - size not given, so assay_class left out for them. EP61 is an evolved ethanol-tolerant strain; its mutations and parent are not stated, so perturbed_genes/strain_group left out. Phase mid_exponential inferred from A600 0.3 in M9 glucose, kept for T1 (10 min) and T2 (70 min) per the <=2 h rule. Ethanol 40 g/L labelled envelope_solvent_biocide.

growth_phase.q: Ethanol was added to 40 g/L once A600 of cultures reached 0.3.
